name: Ray Time To Shine Underarm Serum | Brightening Underarm Serum with Niacinamide, Alpha Arbutin & Hyaluronic Acid | Lightweight Daily Care | 30ml
description:
Give your underarms the care they deserve with Ray Time To Shine Underarm Serum. This lightweight, fast-absorbing formula is enriched with Glycolic Acid, Niacinamide, Kojic Acid, Alpha Arbutin, and moisturizing ingredients that help improve the appearance of dark underarms, support a more even-looking skin tone, and keep the skin soft, smooth, and refreshed.

Key Features
Enriched with Glycolic Acid, Niacinamide, Kojic Acid, and Alpha Arbutin
Helps improve the appearance of dark underarms
Supports a brighter and more even-looking skin tone
Helps soften and smooth rough underarm skin
Lightweight, fast-absorbing, and non-sticky formula
Provides long-lasting hydration and comfort
Helps keep underarms feeling fresh throughout the day
Gentle formula suitable for daily use
Suitable for both men and women
Suitable for all skin types

Product Specifications
Product Type: Underarm Brightening Serum
Volume: 30ml
Texture: Lightweight Serum
Skin Type: All Skin Types
Usage Area: Underarms
Suitable For: Men and Women

How to Use
Clean and dry your underarms thoroughly
Apply 2–3 drops to each underarm
Massage gently until fully absorbed
Allow the serum to dry before applying deodorant or clothing
Use morning and evening for best results
Apply sunscreen if the treated area will be exposed to sunlight

Material / Composition
Glycolic Acid
Niacinamide
Kojic Acid
Alpha Arbutin
Acetyl Tetrapeptide
Capryloyl Glycine
Moisturizing Agents
Purified Water

Safety Information
For external use only
Perform a patch test before first use
Avoid contact with eyes
Do not apply to broken or irritated skin
Discontinue use if irritation occurs
Keep out of reach of children
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
